verdict.rationale: Entrust Identity Verification is a SaaS API and SDK platform, a kind of product that could plausibly publish an official MCP server, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents REST APIs, OAuth, SDKs, webhooks and an llms.txt docs file, but nothing about an MCP server. An llms.txt file is LLM-readable documentation, not an MCP server, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
